decision.explanation: The source documents present two distinct, conflicting assertions regarding the location of the 'Kate Chopin House'. Document 1 (D1S1, D1S3) explicitly states the house was in 'Cloutierville, Louisiana' (specifically Natchitoches Parish). Document 2 (D2S1, D2S3) explicitly states the house was in 'New Orleans, Louisiana' (specifically Orleans Parish). Both documents describe the same entity name ('Kate Chopin House') and provide specific street addresses within their respective cities. Per the instruction to keep supported alternate referents and treat competing assertions as potentially distinct valid answers (or unresolved conflicts requiring both), both locations are retained. Other candidates like parish names or street names are sub-components of these primary locations, while alternative names (Alexis/Alexic Cloutier House, Bayou Folk Museum) are aliases, not locations.
